body.yaml:
---
schemaVersion: "1"
nodeTypes:
  Company:
    label: "기업"
    description: "사업을 하는 법인이다. 상장 여부와 관계없이 담는다."
    labelProperty: "name"
    properties:
      name:
        type: "string"
        label: "기업 이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "기업의 공식 이름. 예: 삼성전자"
      country:
        type: "enum"
        label: "국가"
        required: false
        values:
        - "KR"
        - "US"
        - "JP"
        - "CN"
        - "TW"
        - "HK"
        - "NL"
        - "DE"
        - "GB"
        - "FR"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          KR: "대한민국 (KR)"
          US: "미국 (US)"
          JP: "일본 (JP)"
          CN: "중국 (CN)"
          TW: "대만 (TW)"
          HK: "홍콩 (HK)"
          NL: "네덜란드 (NL)"
          DE: "독일 (DE)"
          GB: "영국 (GB)"
          FR: "프랑스 (FR)"
          OTHER: "기타"
        valueAliases:
          KR:
          - "한국"
          - "대한민국"
          - "남한"
          - "KOR"
          - "Korea"
          - "South Korea"
          US:
          - "미국"
          - "USA"
          - "United States"
          JP:
          - "일본"
          - "JPN"
          - "Japan"
          CN:
          - "중국"
          - "CHN"
          - "China"
          TW:
          - "대만"
          - "TWN"
          - "Taiwan"
          HK:
          - "홍콩"
          - "HKG"
          - "Hong Kong"
          NL:
          - "네덜란드"
          - "NLD"
          - "Netherlands"
          DE:
          - "독일"
          - "DEU"
          - "Germany"
          GB:
          - "영국"
          - "GBR"
          - "UK"
          - "United Kingdom"
          FR:
          - "프랑스"
          - "FRA"
          - "France"
        description: "기업이 등록된 나라"
      registrationNumber:
        type: "string"
        label: "법인등록번호"
        required: false
        maxLength: 64
        description: "기업을 구분하는 공적 번호. 모르면 비워 둔다"
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "메모"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: "기업에 대해 남겨 둘 메모"
    hintProperties:
    - "country"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#2563eb"
      shape: "ellipse"
  Security:
    label: "종목"
    description: "시장에서 거래되는 종목이다. 같은 기업의 여러 상장과 이름이 같은 종목을 시장과 종목 코드로 구분한다."
    labelProperty: "name"
    properties:
      market:
        type: "enum"
        label: "상장 시장"
        required: true
        values:
        - "KRX_KOSPI"
        - "KRX_KOSDAQ"
        - "NASDAQ"
        - "NYSE"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          KRX_KOSPI: "코스피"
          KRX_KOSDAQ: "코스닥"
          NASDAQ: "나스닥"
          NYSE: "뉴욕증권거래소"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "종목이 거래되는 시장"
      ticker:
        type: "string"
        label: "종목 코드"
        required: true
        maxLength: 32
        description: "시장 안에서 쓰는 종목 코드. 예: 005930"
      name:
        type: "string"
        label: "종목 이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "종목의 이름. 예: 삼성전자 보통주"
      securityType:
        type: "enum"
        label: "종목 종류"
        required: false
        values:
        - "COMMON"
        - "PREFERRED"
        - "ETF"
        - "ADR"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          COMMON: "보통주"
          PREFERRED: "우선주"
          ETF: "ETF"
          ADR: "예탁증서(ADR)"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "주식의 종류"
      currency:
        type: "enum"
        label: "거래 통화"
        required: false
        values:
        - "KRW"
        - "USD"
        - "JPY"
        - "CNY"
        - "TWD"
        - "HKD"
        - "EUR"
        - "GBP"
        valueLabels:
          KRW: "원 (KRW)"
          USD: "미국 달러 (USD)"
          JPY: "엔 (JPY)"
          CNY: "위안 (CNY)"
          TWD: "대만 달러 (TWD)"
          HKD: "홍콩 달러 (HKD)"
          EUR: "유로 (EUR)"
          GBP: "파운드 (GBP)"
        valueAliases:
          KRW:
          - "원"
          - "원화"
          - "₩"
          - "한국 원"
          USD:
          - "달러"
          - "미국 달러"
          - "미화"
          - "$"
          - "US$"
          JPY:
          - "엔"
          - "엔화"
          - "¥"
          CNY:
          - "위안"
          - "위안화"
          - "RMB"
          TWD:
          - "대만 달러"
          - "NT$"
          HKD:
          - "홍콩 달러"
          - "HK$"
          EUR:
          - "유로"
          - "€"
          GBP:
          - "파운드"
          - "£"
        description: "종목이 거래되는 통화"
    hintProperties:
    - "market"
    - "ticker"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#0d9488"
      shape: "ellipse"
  Sector:
    label: "산업"
    description: "기업이 속하고 병목이 생기는 산업이다."
    labelProperty: "name"
    properties:
      name:
        type: "string"
        label: "산업 이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "산업의 이름. 예: 반도체"
      scheme:
        type: "string"
        label: "분류 체계"
        required: false
        maxLength: 64
        description: "산업을 나눈 기준의 이름. 예: GICS, KSIC"
      code:
        type: "string"
        label: "분류 코드"
        required: false
        maxLength: 32
        description: "분류 체계 안에서 쓰는 코드"
    hintProperties:
    - "scheme"
    - "code"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#9333ea"
      shape: "hexagon"
  Document:
    label: "근거 문서"
    description: "판단과 주장의 근거가 되는 자료다. 서버가 주소를 읽어 오지 않으므로 사람이 자료 정보를 직접 등록한다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "제목"
        required: true
        maxLength: 300
        description: "자료의 제목"
      url:
        type: "url"
        label: "주소"
        required: true
        maxLength: 2000
        description: "자료 주소. https:// 를 빼고 적으면 저장할 때 붙인다"
      publisher:
        type: "string"
        label: "발행처"
        required: false
        maxLength: 200
        description: "자료를 낸 곳. 예: 금융감독원, 한국경제"
      documentType:
        type: "enum"
        label: "자료 종류"
        required: false
        values:
        - "FILING"
        - "NEWS"
        - "REPORT"
        - "IR"
        - "BOOK"
        - "LETTER"
        - "SPEECH"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          FILING: "공시"
          NEWS: "뉴스"
          REPORT: "보고서"
          IR: "IR 자료"
          BOOK: "책"
          LETTER: "서한"
          SPEECH: "강연과 인터뷰"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "자료의 성격"
      publishedAt:
        type: "date"
        label: "공개일"
        required: false
        description: "자료가 공개된 날. 모르면 비워 둔다"
      collectedAt:
        type: "datetime"
        label: "수집 시각"
        required: true
        description: "이 자료를 확인한 시각"
    hintProperties:
    - "publisher"
    - "publishedAt"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#d97706"
      shape: "round-rectangle"
  Person:
    label: "인물"
    description: "투자자, 경영자, 경제학자 같은 인물이다."
    labelProperty: "name"
    properties:
      name:
        type: "string"
        label: "이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "인물의 이름. 예: 워런 버핏"
      englishName:
        type: "string"
        label: "영문 이름"
        required: false
        maxLength: 200
        description: "영문 이름. 검색에 쓴다. 예: Warren Buffett"
      role:
        type: "enum"
        label: "구분"
        required: false
        values:
        - "INVESTOR"
        - "EXECUTIVE"
        - "ECONOMIST"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          INVESTOR: "투자자"
          EXECUTIVE: "경영자"
          ECONOMIST: "경제학자"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "인물이 주로 한 일"
      country:
        type: "enum"
        label: "국가"
        required: false
        values:
        - "KR"
        - "US"
        - "JP"
        - "CN"
        - "TW"
        - "HK"
        - "NL"
        - "DE"
        - "GB"
        - "FR"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          KR: "대한민국 (KR)"
          US: "미국 (US)"
          JP: "일본 (JP)"
          CN: "중국 (CN)"
          TW: "대만 (TW)"
          HK: "홍콩 (HK)"
          NL: "네덜란드 (NL)"
          DE: "독일 (DE)"
          GB: "영국 (GB)"
          FR: "프랑스 (FR)"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "주로 활동한 나라"
      birthYear:
        type: "integer"
        label: "태어난 해"
        required: false
        min: 1000.0
        max: 2100.0
        description: "태어난 해. 예: 1930"
      deathYear:
        type: "integer"
        label: "세상을 떠난 해"
        required: false
        min: 1000.0
        max: 2100.0
        description: "살아 있으면 비워 둔다"
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "소개"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: "인물을 소개하는 글"
      nickname:
        type: "string"
        label: "별명"
        required: false
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "role"
    - "country"
    searchProperties:
    - "englishName"
    display:
      color: "#db2777"
      shape: "round-tag"
  Concept:
    label: "개념"
    description: "안전마진, 경제적 해자 같은 투자 개념과 원칙이다."
    labelProperty: "name"
    properties:
      name:
        type: "string"
        label: "개념 이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "개념의 이름. 예: 안전마진"
      englishName:
        type: "string"
        label: "영문 이름"
        required: false
        maxLength: 200
        description: "영문 이름. 검색에 쓴다. 예: Margin of Safety"
      category:
        type: "enum"
        label: "분류"
        required: false
        values:
        - "VALUATION"
        - "BUSINESS"
        - "RISK"
        - "BEHAVIOR"
        - "STRATEGY"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          VALUATION: "가치 평가"
          BUSINESS: "사업의 질"
          RISK: "위험 관리"
          BEHAVIOR: "투자 심리"
          STRATEGY: "투자 방식"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: "개념이 다루는 영역"
      summary:
        type: "string"
        label: "한 줄 정의"
        required: true
        maxLength: 300
        description: "개념을 한 문장으로 정의한다"
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "설명"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: "더 자세한 설명"
    hintProperties:
    - "category"
    searchProperties:
    - "englishName"
    display:
      color: "#475569"
      shape: "round-pentagon"
  Change:
    label: "세상의 변화"
    description: "투자 판단에 영향을 주는 세상의 변화다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "변화"
        required: true
        maxLength: 300
        description: "변화를 한 문장으로 적는다. 예: AI 서버가 늘면서 고성능 메모리 수요가 커진다"
      category:
        type: "enum"
        label: "분류"
        required: true
        values:
        - "TECHNOLOGY"
        - "DEMOGRAPHIC"
        - "SOCIOCULTURAL"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          TECHNOLOGY: "기술"
          DEMOGRAPHIC: "인구"
          SOCIOCULTURAL: "사회와 문화"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: ""
      since:
        type: "string"
        label: "언제부터"
        required: false
        maxLength: 64
        description: "예: 2023년부터. 모르면 비워 둔다"
      durability:
        type: "text"
        label: "오래 가는 이유"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "메모"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "category"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#0891b2"
      shape: "round-pentagon"
  Bottleneck:
    label: "병목"
    description: "수요를 공급이 따라가지 못하는 구간이다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "병목"
        required: true
        maxLength: 300
        description: "수요를 공급이 따라가지 못하는 구간. 예: HBM 생산과 고적층 패키징"
      status:
        type: "enum"
        label: "상태"
        required: true
        values:
        - "HYPOTHESIS"
        - "CONFIRMED"
        - "RESOLVED"
        valueLabels:
          HYPOTHESIS: "가설"
          CONFIRMED: "확인"
          RESOLVED: "해소"
        description: ""
      demandEvidence:
        type: "text"
        label: "수요 근거"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
      supplyConstraint:
        type: "text"
        label: "공급 제약"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
      resolutionPath:
        type: "text"
        label: "해소 경로"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: "증설, 대체 기술처럼 병목이 풀릴 길"
      expectedResolution:
        type: "string"
        label: "예상 해소 시점"
        required: false
        maxLength: 64
        description: "예: 2027년 하반기. 모르면 비워 둔다"
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "메모"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "status"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#dc2626"
      shape: "hexagon"
  Valuation:
    label: "밸류에이션"
    description: "한 기업의 가치를 한 기준일에 평가한 기록이다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "예: FLNC 2026-09-14"
      asOf:
        type: "date"
        label: "기준일"
        required: false
        description: "평가한 날. 모르면 비워 둔다"
      currentPrice:
        type: "number"
        label: "현재가"
        required: true
        min: 0.0
        description: "기준일의 주가"
      currency:
        type: "enum"
        label: "통화"
        required: false
        values:
        - "KRW"
        - "USD"
        - "JPY"
        - "CNY"
        - "TWD"
        - "HKD"
        - "EUR"
        - "GBP"
        valueLabels:
          KRW: "원 (KRW)"
          USD: "미국 달러 (USD)"
          JPY: "엔 (JPY)"
          CNY: "위안 (CNY)"
          TWD: "대만 달러 (TWD)"
          HKD: "홍콩 달러 (HKD)"
          EUR: "유로 (EUR)"
          GBP: "파운드 (GBP)"
        description: ""
      method:
        type: "enum"
        label: "방법"
        required: false
        values:
        - "PER"
        - "PBR"
        - "EV_SALES"
        - "EV_EBITDA"
        - "DCF"
        - "REVERSE_DCF"
        - "OTHER"
        valueLabels:
          PER: "PER"
          PBR: "PBR"
          EV_SALES: "EV/매출"
          EV_EBITDA: "EV/EBITDA"
          DCF: "DCF"
          REVERSE_DCF: "역DCF"
          OTHER: "기타"
        description: ""
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "메모"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "asOf"
    - "method"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#16a34a"
      shape: "round-rectangle"
  Scenario:
    label: "시나리오"
    description: "비관, 기준, 낙관 가운데 한 가정으로 계산한 주당 가치다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "예: FLNC 비관"
      kind:
        type: "enum"
        label: "종류"
        required: true
        values:
        - "BEAR"
        - "BASE"
        - "BULL"
        valueLabels:
          BEAR: "비관"
          BASE: "기준"
          BULL: "낙관"
        description: ""
      valuePerShare:
        type: "number"
        label: "주당 가치"
        required: true
        min: 0.0
        description: "밸류에이션과 같은 통화. 범위로 받았으면 중간값을 넣고 범위는 메모에 적는다"
      assumptions:
        type: "text"
        label: "핵심 가정"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
      description:
        type: "text"
        label: "메모"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "kind"
    - "valuePerShare"
    searchProperties: []
    display:
      color: "#65a30d"
      shape: "round-tag"
  Decision:
    label: "투자 결정"
    description: "종목에 대해 내린 투자 행동의 기록이다."
    labelProperty: "title"
    properties:
      title:
        type: "string"
        label: "이름"
        required: true
        maxLength: 200
        description: "예: FLNC 첫 매수"
      action:
        type: "enum"
        label: "행동"
        required: true
        values:
        - "WATCH"
        - "BUY"
        - "ADD"
        - "TRIM"
        - "EXIT"
        - "HOLD"
        valueLabels:
          WATCH: "관심 등록"
          BUY: "매수"
          ADD: "추가 매수"
          TRIM: "일부 매도"
          EXIT: "전량 매도"
          HOLD: "보류"
        description: ""
      decidedAt:
        type: "date"
        label: "결정일"
        required: false
        description: "모르면 비워 둔다"
      reason:
        type: "text"
        label: "이유"
        required: false
        maxLength: 4000
        description: ""
    hintProperties:
    - "action"
    - "decidedAt"
    searchProperties: []
